notes.title: Game Update 5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Medieval Battle: Europe - version 3.1.1 update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Medieval Battle: Europe Update 3.1.0
notes.content:
Change: A reduction in the download size.
 Change: Campaign map graphics. It is now clearer which campaigns have been completed.
 Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
 Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Units will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
Fix: An issue with image scaling on older Apple iOS devices.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.
 Fix: A critical issue displaying the curved loss meters after the previous graphics update.
 Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
 Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.
 Fix: Some unit animations working erratically.Update: Play balance in some missionsUpdate: Source material credits.

notes.title: Update.
notes.content: Fix: A major update to the game AI.  Ranged units that were far from enemy units are now more responsive.

notes.title: Update.
notes.content:
Fix: Some minor bug fixes.
Change: Some unit AI behaviour.
Change: Added a curved strength meter.
